thread:
Camila Reyes: kicking off the customer reference program workstream in here. goal: lock owners + publish targets + map which stories ladder to Dedicated vs Private positioning. dropping the draft plan doc link (wip): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/Reference_Program_Project_Plan

Soojin Lee: +1. also need to be super explicit in the mapping so Sales isn’t trying to use Arcadia as a Dedicated proof point etc.

Ben Carter: for web rollout, I just need: (a) which 3–5 we’re committing to publish, (b) rough dates, (c) which ones require gated/internal first. ENG is building the case studies section but we can stage pages.

Camila Reyes: proposed “top 3” to start (based on current momentum):
- Arcadia Health = Private/VPC + compliance + audit logs
- QuantaPay = Dedicated capacity + strict latency SLOs
- NovaDocs = Hosted API + Optimize (cost/perf wins)
then keep HelioSupport + VectorForge as backup/reference-call-first.

Ethan Wallace: works for me. if we do 3, I can run 2 interviews/week without it turning into chaos.

Tessa Morgan: from design side, 3 is ideal for the first PDF template pass. we can templatize and then just swap diagram + metrics blocks.

Priyom Das: QuantaPay will probably say yes *if* we hit the POC thresholds. I can own the “conditional yes → legal approval” handoff, but I need a crisp “what we’re asking for” doc.

Avery Johnson: Arcadia is touchy on what can be public. they’re open to a story but likely w/ restrictions (no exact regions, no detailed infra diagram). Rachel + I can manage expectations.

Rachel Kim: for reference calls: Arcadia champion is willing but wants to cap frequency. we should codify that in the profile (e.g., 1 call/month, 2 weeks notice).

Soojin Lee: mapping draft (pls sanity check):

PRIVATE (VPC/on-prem) positioning:
- Arcadia Health: regulated workload, private networking, audit logs, KMS/key ownership language, deployment flexibility.

DEDICATED positioning:
- QuantaPay: reserved GPU pool, predictable throughput, latency p95 guardrails, autoscaling/burst policy.

HOSTED + OPTIMIZE positioning:
- NovaDocs: embeddings + rerank + caching/batching recs, lower cost/query, faster time-to-value.

Reference-call-only candidates (for now):
- HelioSupport: streaming stability + fallback/routing story (but POC still in flight)
- VectorForge: structured output/tool calling + open-model preference (could become performance story)

Ben Carter: this is great. for the case studies landing page, we’ll probably have filters by “Deployment: Hosted / Dedicated / Private”. so we should tag each story accordingly.

Camila Reyes: owners proposal (RACI-ish):
- Arcadia (Private): Writer = Ethan, PMM/messaging = Soojin, AE/relationship = Avery, CS = Rachel, SE validation = Markus, Legal = Sofia/Michael.
- QuantaPay (Dedicated): Writer = Ethan, PMM = Soojin, AE = Priyom, CS = Miguel (looped later), SE = Simran/Markus, Legal = Sofia/Michael.
- NovaDocs (Hosted/Optimize): Writer = Ethan, PMM = Soojin, Growth/web = Ben (publish), CS owner TBD but likely Miguel, SE validation = Logan (metrics).

Jordan Blake: keep it tight. 3 public case studies is the bar for this quarter. dedicated + private are priority for sales-assisted motion. hosted is good for PLG credibility but don’t let it block the other two.

Tyler Benson: tracking question: do we want a single HubSpot property set for “case study status” + “reference call readiness”? I can stand up a quick tracker but need a consistent stage list.

Camila Reyes: yes. stage list suggestion:
1) Targeted
2) Contacted
3) Agreed in principle
4) Interviewed
5) Metrics validated
6) Draft shared
7) Customer redlines
8) Legal/release complete
9) Design/layout
10) Published

Soojin Lee: can we add a “claims locked” checkpoint? we keep getting into loops where metrics language changes after design.

Tessa Morgan: +1. if numbers/claims move late it breaks the layout. maybe “Metrics/claims locked” between 5 and 6.

Ben Carter: re: dates — what’s realistic? if we want these live before end of quarter, we need at least one story shipped in ~6–7 weeks.

Camila Reyes: proposed targets (aggressive but doable if customers respond):
- NovaDocs (Hosted/Optimize) publish target: week of Nov 25 (lowest legal friction)
- QuantaPay (Dedicated) publish target: week of Dec 9 (depends on POC + metrics validation)
- Arcadia (Private) publish target: week of Dec 16 (expect security/legal review cycles)

Avery Johnson: Arcadia in mid-Dec feels right. they have a security review board that meets biweekly. if we miss a window it slips.

Priyom Das: QuantaPay — agree, but we should set expectation internally that “publish” might be early Jan if legal redlines take time. they’re picky on comparative claims.

Markus Klein: SE capacity: we can support validation calls for all 3, but we need the metrics worksheet populated early. please don’t send me a draft with “~40% faster” without a measurement note :)

Ethan Wallace: for interviews, I want 2 sessions/customer:
- Eng lead (architecture + implementation)
- Business owner (why it mattered + adoption + outcomes)
if someone can help book those w/ champions, that’ll keep me moving.

Rachel Kim: I can handle booking for Arcadia and NovaDocs with CS contacts. QuantaPay will probably be Priyom-led.

Camila Reyes: next steps (today/tomorrow):
- Soojin: post the messaging angle + “approved claims language” guardrails we’re using (esp latency/cost wording)
- Tyler: create the tracker + stage list in HubSpot + share link here
- Ethan: send interview slots you want held next week
- Ben/Tessa: align on the minimal page + PDF template requirements so we don’t block on perfect design

Ben Carter: for web, MVP = 1 landing page + 3 story pages (can be “Coming soon” placeholders internally). SEO can wait.

Soojin Lee: I’ll drop the “Dedicated vs Private proof points” bullets in a doc and link it. also: reminder we need to avoid overpromising SLAs in public copy unless Legal confirms.

Jordan Blake: also please make sure Sales knows: reference calls are a privilege not a right. we need a clear intake + routing rule so we don’t burn champions.

Camila Reyes: yep. I’ll sync with Stephanie/Lukas separately and we’ll post the reference-call request process in #announcements once finalized. :thumbsup:

Tyler Benson: cool, I’ll draft the HubSpot fields + a simple form for “reference request” and share for review.

Tessa Morgan: send me one “golden” draft as soon as Ethan has it (even if not perfect). I can start building the layout components off real content.

Ethan Wallace: ack. I’ll start with NovaDocs since it’s likely the cleanest publish path.

Camila Reyes: locking decisions from this thread:
- Commit to 3 public case studies: NovaDocs (Hosted/Optimize), QuantaPay (Dedicated), Arcadia Health (Private)
- Backups / reference-call-only for now: HelioSupport, VectorForge
- Publish targets: Nov 25 / Dec 9 / Dec 16 (with QuantaPay possibly slipping to Jan)
- Owners per story as listed above
I’ll paste this into the project plan doc.

Ben Carter: :white_check_mark: once Tyler drops tracker link, I’ll wire it to our internal checklist.

Soojin Lee: + I’ll start a “claims language” snippet we can reuse across all 3 so we’re consistent (e.g., ‘observed p95 latency improvements over a 14-day window on production traffic’).

Markus Klein: thank you. that phrasing makes my life easier.
